title: Lower integral over the closed ball equals the Bochner integral over the open ball (Simon 4.5, proof step (20a))
statement: Let n be a natural number, φ : R^n → R and r > 0, where R^n = EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) carries Lebesgue measure L^n = volume. Assume φ is continuous on the closed ball B̄_r(0) and φ(x) >= 0 for every x in B̄_r(0). Then ∫⁻_{B̄_r(0)} ofReal(φ) dL^n = ofReal(∫_{B_r(0)} φ dL^n), where B_r(0) is the open ball and the right-hand integral is the Bochner integral.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ContinuousOn φ (closedBall 0 r) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, 0 ≤ φ x) → ∫⁻ x in closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, φ x)
